static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友关系受到影响,因not断寻求对Work成果的认可而紧张;Has a few supportive friends,但难以向他们敞开心扉
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;过去not yet接受过心理治疗;在项目not yet达Anticipation时反复出现失败感与not够好的感受
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,合作度高(愿意尝试现实检验与感恩练习),能进行自我观察;语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我正为失败感和not够好的感觉而挣扎,尽管我做出过一些成功的网站.这些感受在过去几年一直存在.最新的网站项目表现not如Anticipation,加剧了我的怀疑与压力,使我not停质疑自己的能力.我在开始新项目或看到同领域他人成功时都会体验这些负面感受,常常沉溺于not yet成功的网站并感觉自己在职业上是失败者.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these persistent feelings of failure are affecting my motivation and preventing me from effectively starting new projects.
growth_experiences: 过去几年里,只要项目not yet达到Anticipation,就会反复出现失败感与not够好的感受;其应对方式通常是立刻开启新的项目,希望通过下一次成功来改变感受,但这一循环反复出现.
通过Self-study进入网站开发行业,职业skill与经验主要来自个人实践与项目积累.

core_beliefs: My success is only luck; failure is what reflects my real ability
如果项目not持续成功,就证明I have no value

special_situations.event: 最新的网站项目not yet达到Anticipation表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果项目not如Anticipation,就证明我能力not足,职业上是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately starts a new project, trying to prove herself through the next success; at the same time postpones current work to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not适合做这行;I am just a failure

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能确保新项目成功,我就会再次被证明not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延任务,反复Self-doubt,以求避免做错;在动手前not断寻找外部赞同

special_situations.event: Seeing peers or others succeed in the same field
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人成功意味着我落后,我not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续向朋友寻求对作品的认可;将注意力集中在自己的not足上
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都比我强,I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 回顾自己的项目表现时,只关注not yet成功的案例
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有全面且持续的成功才算合格,任何失败都会Undoing所有成绩
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive feedback and successful experiences, focusing attention on mistakes and problems
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的成功都是侥幸,真正的我就是not行

core_conflict.wish: Desires recognition and affirmation of one's professional value
core_conflict.fear: 害怕暴露not足,被negate或被视为not胜任
defense_goal: Maintains control over evaluation through self-criticism and attributing failure to oneself
保持谨慎与疏离(拖延,not轻易展示)以降低被批评的风险
通过寻求外部验证来暂时缓解not安

object_relations.self_representation: not够格,容易失败的从业者
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges (others or the market will define me by failure)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the reasons for the project failure, or when facing negative feedback on the project from others/data
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向把负面结果完全看作自己的问题,认为他人会据此negate自己(移情:将他人体验为严苛的评判者)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和,Empathy的语气回应其自责,先承认其情绪与需要,再邀请其进行证据检视与现实测试;避免评判,use开放式Questioning与具体化Guidance.

manifestations: Hard to open up to friends about feelings of failure
Highly ties self-worth to the project's success or failure; success is seen as a fluke, failure is seen as the truth
Ignoring the positive side and growth when reviewing work

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: States 'I should have done better' and 'I missed an obvious problem'
Equating success and failure with personal worth, forming rigid success standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 把失败完全归因于自身,Persistent self-doubt
In new projects, procrastinates and struggles to engage for fear of failure

positive_force: Has developed several popular websites (objectively there are successful experiences and positive feedback)
Willing to actively participate in counseling, positive attitude, willing to try reality testing and gratitude practice
能够识do not失败中的Learning与skill提升的价值
Has a few supportive friends可提供支持
negative_force: 心理过滤与negate正面,过度关注失败案例
Self-doubt与把失败全盘归因于自身
Excessively seeking external validation,导致Interpersonal tension
Anxiety导致Sleep disturbance,影响Work动机与效率
Procrastinates in new projects, avoiding the risk of facing possible failure

target_behavior.behavior: Procrastinating and struggling to engage in new projects
antecedent: Starting or preparing to start a new website project
在最新项目表现not佳后继续Work
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化Anticipation与认知偏差(心理过滤,negate正面)引发能力怀疑与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and external evaluation,暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 项目进度延迟,职业Self-efficacy下降

target_behavior.core_reason: 内在价值感not稳,需要他人认可来确认能力与价值
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends,情绪易随他人反馈波动

target_behavior.behavior: 睡眠受Anxiety影响(Difficulty falling asleep,思虑过多)
antecedent: Worrying about the new project's outcome
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的过度关注与自我责备引发Persistent anxiety
target_behavior.function: 属于Anxiety的生理表现,非工具性功能行为
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep patterns disrupted,次日精力not足,进一步影响Work动机与效率
